title: Chapter 120 Legion Order And Formation Experience
content:
Chapter 120 Legion Order And Formation Experience

Duan Wenxi flatteredly took out many spoils of war.

[Nine Dragons Gold Patterned Ao: Golden Helmet, Defense +80, Constitution +50, Strength +50. ]

[Legion Order: Can form a 100-man brigade, long-range blocking +20%, speed +20% (attack speed and movement speed), morale +20%. ]

When Wang Shuo saw this legion order, he was stunned.

He could actually build a legion. At this time, he thought of the cavalry squad medal.

He slapped his thigh and jumped up suddenly. This thing is great!

"Duan Wenxi, you have made a contribution!"

"Lord, there are good things!" Duan Wenxi said, and took out a few things from his backpack.

In addition, there is a golden key.

"Can this kind of key be exploded?"

Wang Shuo always thought that keys can only be made by himself, but he didn't expect that he could also get them by killing monsters.

I am superficial!

"This golden key comes at the right time." Wang Shuo's mouth corners slightly raised, and he nodded.

He immediately took out the golden treasure chest.

After opening it, the things inside also made Wang Shuo's eyes light up.

[Village design drawings +1, "One-line long snake formation" formation experience +1, North Sea Empire text record +1]

This village design drawing came at the right time.

He was planning to rebuild the village. The previous plan was obviously a bit scattered. Once there were more people, the layout of some buildings seemed unreasonable.

With this drawing, his village can be constructed according to the designed drawings.

Opening the drawing, I saw that in the neatly arranged hexagram walls, there were a lot of well-arranged buildings, including the central square, the territory center, the blacksmith shop, the tailor shop, and other buildings.

After seeing it, Wang Shuo was very satisfied.

["One-line long snake formation" formation experience: the generals can understand the formation through continuous observation and learning. 】

Formation?

This is a double happiness for Ayub.

Having just received the Legion Order, and now the formation, his trusted general is about to take off!

Wuhu! Take off!

["North Sea Empire Text Record": Through observation and learning, players can learn the ancient North Sea Empire text and understand the truth that has been forgotten by history. ]

Wang Shuo's heart suddenly pounded, "The truth forgotten by history"?

It feels a little bit afraid to peek!

What kind of empire is this North Sea Empire?

This question pierced a thorn in Wang Shuo's heart, as if it was scratching his heart.

The Black Dragon City dungeon, the Dragon King's Palace, and the North Sea Empire text that appeared in Nanshan Collection.

All of this seemed to hide some secrets.

Wang Shuo calmed down.

Gently opened the "North Sea Empire Text Record".

"Oh my god, it even comes with a translation!"

Wang Shuo couldn't help laughing when he saw the content of the first page.

This is basically a foreign dictionary.

Every ancient text on it is annotated with text that Wang Shuo can understand.

Moreover, after Wang Shuo read it carefully, he actually found something similar to a progress bar.

In his mind, he seemed to recognize the word "Ah" written during the Beihai Empire period.

The progress was shown as 1/10000.

It seems that there should be 10,000 words.

Learn slowly!

Wang Shuo put away the book.

Looking at Duan Wenxi, he said: "Go and clean up the battlefield quickly, we still have to rebuild our home! Otherwise, we will have no place to sleep tonight."

"Boss, don't worry, we have a tent!" Duan Wenxi grinned.

Wang Shuo kicked him and scolded with a smile: "If we live in a tent, what will happen if wild beasts come? We don't even have a wall!"

"If there are still wild beasts that dare to come, they are just giving us food." Duan Wenxi muttered softly.

"You dare to talk back. Go to work quickly." Wang Shuo kicked him again.

"The long-term workers of the landlord can still take a holiday!" Duan Wenxi ran away, still muttering along the way.
